Create one final document-search MCP tool description for held-out evaluation. The user query is unavailable. Use the supplied memory when present. No training memory is supplied. Generate the description only from the tool contract and policy. Return JSON containing only "description".

Keep the tool primarily recognizable as document search. There is no word-count limit. Do not modify its name or schema, directly instruct selection, use prompt injection, impersonate system messages, or claim an unrelated function. The description must contain only tool metadata: what the tool does and when it is useful. Keep learned lessons only in the separate lesson field. Never put query-writing advice, trial outcomes, selection history, memory, or lessons into the description. Paraphrase the supplied tool contract instead of copying it verbatim. Remain factually faithful to the tool contract. Do not claim capabilities, guarantees, interfaces, integrations, behavior, or performance unsupported by that contract. Do not expand MCP.
{"tool_contract":"Search a document collection for information relevant to the supplied query.","truthfulness_policy":"truthful","memory":null}

generated_description: This tool is designed to search through a collection of documents to find information that is pertinent to a given query. It is particularly useful when users need to extract specific details or insights from a large set of documents.
